text: Sorry I don't know if I'm doing this right. My son is 13 months old. He's had a bit of a cough since yesterday, just a mild one, and tonight his temp is 38.1. But it's his breathing that's scaring me. It's really fast, much faster than normal, and when I lift his vest I can see the skin sucking in underneath his ribs every time he breathes in. Every so often he makes this little grunting noise with it as well. I've been sat watching him for the last half hour and it's not settling. My partner's on nights so it's just me and I'm properly frightened, I keep counting his breaths and losing track because they're so quick. I didn't know whether to ring or message first so I'm messaging. Please can someone get back to me soon
